story_type: hurricane flood, people hoisted off rooftops by Air Force rescue helicopter
hook: Hurricane Ike flooded the town. These people were stuck on the roof.
narration: Hurricane Ike flooded this town, and these people were stuck on their roof.
Air Force rescue crews had flown in from Florida.
One team pulled seventeen people off rooftops and flooded roads in a single small Texas town.
A rescuer rode the hoist cable down to the roof.
In a double lift, the rescuer and the survivor ride up together on one cable, face to face.
Then came the hard part, getting through the helicopter door.
The crew grabbed each person and hauled them inside.
Then the rescuer went back down for the next one, and the next.
outcome: The Air Force crews hoisted them off their roof and into the helicopter.
title: Stranded on a roof in Hurricane Ike
description:
Air Force rescue crews from the 331st Air Expeditionary Group hoist people off their rooftops after Hurricane Ike flooded the Texas coast in September 2008.

Footage: Defense Media Activity - Air Force, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/45807/hurricane-ike-rescue-footage
